name: kimi-dashboard
description: Kimi Code quota (5h / 7d / booster), context and session info always visible in the kimi-code footer. Not an official Moonshot project.
author: kimi-dashboard contributors

interface.shortDescription: 额度 5h/7d、加油包、context、会话信息常驻底栏
interface.longDescription: 把 /usage 里的官方额度、context 占用、token 数、模式、分支、目录和会话时长画进 kimi-code 底栏第一行。安装后每次会话启动会自动把 status_line.command 指向本插件，执行 /reload 即生效；也可以用 /kimi-dashboard:setup、/kimi-dashboard:doctor、/kimi-dashboard:preview。只读取凭证，永不刷新 token。
